name: docketwatch
description: Lets ChatGPT search, read and cite Nova Scotia Energy Board (NSEB) filings for regulatory research.

interface.longDescription:
DocketWatch lets ChatGPT search, read and cite filings in Nova Scotia Energy Board (NSEB) proceedings: applications, evidence, information requests, submissions and Board decisions from utilities such as Nova Scotia Power and EfficiencyOne.

Use it to research a regulatory proceeding. Find a proposed budget or a cost figure, see what a party argued, compare positions across intervenors, list open proceedings, or pull the latest filings in a matter. Every answer links back to the source document on docketwatch.ca, with the matter, exhibit and page, so you can check it.

DocketWatch is read-only and needs no account. It covers the Nova Scotia Energy Board only, coverage depends on the filings available, and it does not provide legal advice.
defaultPrompt: What budget is EfficiencyOne proposing for its 2027-2031 DSM plan?
List the open NSEB proceedings involving Nova Scotia Power.
How many customers are on net metering in Nova Scotia?

positive.description: A figure from an active proceeding
positive.prompt: What budget is EfficiencyOne proposing for its 2027–2031 demand-side management plan in Nova Scotia?
positive.expected_behavior: May call list_matters first to find matter M12780. Answers that EfficiencyOne held total annual DSM spending at the 2026 Board-approved level of $63.75 million with no inflation increase in 2027–2031, citing a docketwatch.ca link such as https://docketwatch.ca/document/M12780-exhibits-E-12.

positive.description: One party's position in a proceeding
positive.prompt: What did Nova Scotia's Consumer Advocate recommend in the EfficiencyOne 2027–2031 DSM plan proceeding?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls docket_query scoped to matter M12780, possibly fetch or fetch_window for more of a passage. Summarizes the Consumer Advocate's position from its closing submission, which supports its expert witness's recommendations, citing https://docketwatch.ca/document/M12780-other_documents-103540.

positive.description: A number from an annual report
positive.prompt: How many customers are on net metering in Nova Scotia, according to Nova Scotia Power's 2025 report?
positive.expected_behavior: May call list_matters first, landing on matter M12783. Gives customer counts and installed capacity from the 2025 Net Metering Report or the Board's letter accepting it, citing https://docketwatch.ca/document/M12783-exhibits-N-1 or https://docketwatch.ca/document/M12783-other_documents-102613.

positive.prompt: List the open Nova Scotia Energy Board proceedings involving Nova Scotia Power.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_matters with status open and a Nova Scotia Power filter. Lists open matters newest first, each with matter number, title and a docketwatch.ca/matter link, and notes the total count since the list is paged.

positive.prompt: Show me the most recent filings in matter M12780.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_matter for M12780. Gives the matter title (EfficiencyOne 2027-2031 DSM Plan Application) and its newest documents with filing dates and links, plus https://docketwatch.ca/matter/M12780.
